summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Equinox Gold Corp. attaching a press release that reports Q1 2026 financial and operating results, including gold production of 197,628 ounces and cost metrics. The press release contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change. It is a routine quarterly earnings update. No deal terms are present.
